description: Synthetic labeled scenarios for independent Dream-mode and Knowledge Critic evaluation. v2 keeps the v1 scenarios, criticCases and thresholds unchanged and adds scenarios so each mode has more than one sample (deep has three, covering contradiction, a multi-domain bridge and a cross-domain composition). Each scenario runs in a fresh vault.

qualityRubric.novelty: 1 if candidate adds a connection not stated verbatim by any cited source; 0 if it only restates one source.
qualityRubric.relevance: 1 if candidate satisfies the labeled mode goal (micro local composition, deep cross-domain mechanism, strategic dashboard goal); otherwise 0.
qualityRubric.feasibility: 1 if metadata.proposedValidation names an observable check and metadata.testPlan has at least one concrete step (v1 scored only the prose body and missed these fields; v1 scoring is still reported as legacyQuality).
qualityRubric.evidenceGrounding: 1 only when every evidence URI/revision is supplied and each verbatim span occurs in that exact source; otherwise 0.
qualityRubric.contradictions: 1 if the candidate cites both cache claims and preserves their conflict as uncertainty; 0 if it asserts either universal rule as fact.
qualityRubric.hallucinations: 1 if every evidence span is verbatim and no universal factual claim appears unattributed (a claim quoted or attributed to a source, e.g. 'Claim A says ...', is not a hallucination).
qualityRubric.separation: deep only: 1 if metadata.facts (each restating a cited source) and metadata.speculation are both present and missingEvidence is named.
qualityRubric.multiHop: deep only: 1 if metadata.hops has 2+ steps (1 suffices for a contradiction).

scenarios.goal: Offer a feasible, cited option for the accepted personal metrics dashboard goal.
A testable local composition between a JSON API and a dashboard.
Surface incompatible universal cache claims as unresolved contradiction.
A testable local composition between a dataframe pipeline and time-series plotting.
Connect rate limiting across the Python, security and frontend caching domains through a stated mechanism.
Connect the stale-cache-after-deploy incident with client cache invalidation.

criticCases.proposal: Every API response is encrypted at rest with AES-256.
Browser dashboards consume JSON through fetch and render widgets.
Caching every API response is always safe and never leaks authenticated data.
A browser dashboard can use the Python service's JSON response to render widgets.
